raw_text: `.rulesync/` is the source of truth. Author changes in `rules`, `skills`, `subagents`, `commands`, `hooks`, and `mcp` there first. Regenerate outputs; never hand-edit generated targets. Keep root `AGENTS.md` in overview; keep follow-up split rules off AGENTS-writing targets. Use `rulesync generate --check`, then `rulesync generate`; review source/generated diffs. Verify `.rulesync/verification/` checklists. Keep frontmatter compliant, commands deterministic, hooks advisory. Use RuleSync commands directly.
